run_GTNLoss: run the GTNLoss function to compute sequence loss between frame-level inputs and token-level targets
create_GTNLossFunction: create a custom PyTorch autograd Function using GTN graphs for sequence criterion loss computation
build_make_target_graph: build a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to multiple input frames
test_forward_backward: test the forward and backward pass of GTNLossFunction with batched inputs and targets
review_GTNLossFunction: review the GTNLossFunction class that computes loss via graph intersection and forward scoring
